shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on objects, screens, clothing, signs and license plates, except numerals the prompt explicitly asks for. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.counting: Counting photo: every counted object is complete, uncropped, separated from its neighbours by a clear gap, and easy to count on a phone 360 pixels wide. No other object of that kind anywhere, including the background and reflections.
shared_prompts.color: Color photo: exactly ONE object. The whole object is the named color, apart from natural black tires, glass or metal hardware. It is centered, complete and uncropped, and fills about half of the photo width. The background is calm and a clearly different color, so the object's color is unmistakable; no other red, blue, green, yellow, black or white object is large enough to compete.
shared_prompts.first_person: Strict first-person view from the learner's own eyes: the learner's forearms enter from the bottom edge, naturally attached, each hand with five natural fingers, plain charcoal-grey knit sleeves, medium-brown skin, no rings, watches or bracelets. No other people, hands, faces, mirrors or reflections.

assets.prompt: SEVEN chairs, exactly 7. Eye-level photograph of one straight row of seven identical light-oak wooden chairs with plain solid seats and simple slatted backs, standing side by side against a plain off-white wall on pale floorboards in a bright, empty room, all facing the camera. The row is centered and fills about 85 percent of the photo width. A clear gap of floor separates every pair of neighbouring chairs; no chair hides, touches or overlaps another. Every chair is complete from the top of its back to its feet, with floor visible under every foot. No other furniture, people, pictures, plants or objects.

EIGHT books, exactly 8. Photograph looking straight down at a long, bare light-oak table. Eight identical closed hardcover books with plain dark-blue cloth covers and cream page edges lie flat in one straight row, all the same size and turned the same way, with an even strip of bare wood between neighbours. The row is centered and fills about 85 percent of the photo width. The covers are completely blank: no title, text, pattern or picture. Nothing else on the table.

NINE cars, exactly 9. Photograph from directly above, like a drone, of one straight row of nine ordinary small hatchback cars parked side by side in marked spaces on grey asphalt, all facing the same way. Each car is one plain solid color, mixed among white, silver, grey, dark blue and dark red. A painted white line and a clear gap separate every car; no car touches or overlaps another. All nine are complete and the row is centered, filling about 90 percent of the photo width. No license-plate text, people, other vehicles, or trees covering any car.

RED. One bright red city bus, painted solid red, parked alone at an empty curb on a quiet street, seen from the front three-quarter angle and complete from roof to tires. Its destination display is blank and dark: no route number, text, advertising or logos. Soft overcast sky and pale grey buildings behind; no other vehicles and no people.

BLUE. One bicycle with a solid bright blue frame, black tires and a black seat, standing alone on its kickstand in side view on a plain light-grey concrete path in front of a plain pale-beige wall. Complete and centered, both wheels whole. No basket, other bikes, people or text.

GREEN. One simple wooden chair painted solid bright green all over, seat, back and legs, standing alone in three-quarter view on pale oak floorboards in front of a plain off-white wall. Complete from the top of its back to its four feet. No other furniture, plants or objects.

YELLOW. One bright yellow backpack, solid yellow fabric with yellow straps and zipper tape, standing upright alone on a plain light-grey floor in front of a plain light-grey wall, front view, complete and centered. No logos, tags, text or patches.

BLACK. One shiny solid-black small car parked alone on a pale sunlit concrete driveway in front of a plain light-cream wall, seen from the front three-quarter angle, complete with all visible wheels whole. No license plate or a completely blank one; no logos, badges or text; no other vehicles or people.

WHITE. One simple rectangular table painted solid white, with four white legs, standing alone in three-quarter view on warm medium-brown wooden floorboards in front of a plain warm-grey wall. Complete, with nothing on it, and no chairs or other furniture.

NUMBER. Close photograph of the front wall of a house beside its front door: one large house-number plate with the black numerals 24 on a plain white plate, mounted on a pale stone wall. The plate is centered, fills about 40 percent of the photo width, and is sharp and perfectly legible; part of a plain wooden front door shows at the left edge. The only characters anywhere are the 2 and the 4 on the plate: no street name, letters, mailbox text or other numbers. Soft daylight, no people.
